label: Rescue misses
help: Alert when rescue shots fail to raise moisture; never holds watering.

label: Rescue misses before alert
help: Consecutive settled rescue shots without a moisture rise before the alert.

label: Rescues past dead feed probe
help: Allow P3 emergency and watchdog rescues past a dead feed probe; bad readings and other interlocks still hold.

label: Manual shot length
help: Test Shot seconds; maximum duration and daily budget still apply.

label: Waste valve rule
help: Choose Close for each shot to close and verify the waste valve before the pump primes.

label: Pump power sensor
help: Optional room=sensor power mapping enables the dead-head alert; never stops the pump.

label: Pump dead-head power
help: Alert after 60 seconds above this power with all valves shut and no active hold or batch.

label: Tank size for estimate
help: Capacity in litres enables the estimate when no tank level sensor is mapped; zero disables.

label: Estimated tank low alert
help: Estimated percentage at which to alert; the estimate never holds shots.
